title: Too Much of a Good Thing? Speculative Effects on Commodity Futures Curves
summary: Recovered full July2018 source. Contemporaneous monthly curve regressions do not establish an executable forecasting strategy. No return test.
about: Index and hedging positions associated with cocoa, coffee and cotton futures-curve shapes.
findings: Author reports offsetting index/hedger curve associations; key cotton index effects weak/insignificant. Source notes contemporaneous terms/endogeneity. No independent reproduction.
mechanism: Position demand may affect relative maturities; no admissible timing forecast recovered.
build_on: Supporting market hypothesis; do not turn month-end contemporaneous coefficients into pre-publication signals. No ready protocol/exit recovered.
source_revision: SOAS Working Paper211, July2018,19PDFpages; parity with2020accepted/SSRN version unknown
